text: Pointer/callable loads and stores shall target actual matching typed leaves. Record access shall target an actual object/subobject of that nominal record type. Equal byte layouts or a `ptrcast` shall not authorize reinterpretation of unrelated records/references.

obligations.text: Pointer/callable loads and stores shall target actual matching typed leaves.
Record access shall target an actual object/subobject of that nominal record type.
Equal byte layouts or a `ptrcast` shall not authorize reinterpretation of unrelated records/references.
